findings.question: rc-tt-eea-0006
findings.quote: The institutional attribution makes it an editorial.
findings.problem: “Institutional attribution” is unnecessarily abstract for the required Grade 5 explanation. It makes the reader decode two technical words to understand that the view belongs to the newspaper.
findings.fix: Say: “It is an editorial because it gives the newspaper’s view.”

findings.question: rc-tt-eea-0009
findings.quote: This is explicit institutional advocacy about a public issue.
findings.problem: “Explicit institutional advocacy” does not meet the plain Grade 5 English requirement. The phrase obscures the simple point that the board directly states its own view.
findings.fix: Say: “The board directly states its own view about the policy.”
